description: This file contains implementation of functions related to managing data images, including creation, resizing, filesystem type detection, and initialization of various images for the Cuttlefish project. It also includes logic for building and initializing EFI and OS images based on different boot flows.

classes.name: DataImageAction
classes.description: Enumeration representing actions to be taken on data images: no action, create, or resize.

methods.name: ForceFsckImage
methods.description: Runs filesystem check on the data image, correcting errors if possible.

methods.name: ResizeImage
methods.description: Resizes the data image to a specified size in MB, including filesystem checks and resizing.

methods.name: GetFsType
methods.description: Detects the filesystem type of a given device or image.

methods.name: ChooseDataImageAction
methods.description: Determines whether to create, resize, or do nothing with the data image based on current state and policy.

methods.name: CreateBlankImage
methods.description: Creates a new blank image file with specified size and format.

methods.name: InitializeDataImage
methods.description: Initializes the data image according to the specified policy, creating or resizing as needed.

methods.name: InitializeMiscImage
methods.description: Creates an empty miscellaneous partition image if it does not already exist.

methods.name: InitializeEspImage
methods.description: Builds and initializes the EFI System Partition (ESP) image based on boot flow and configuration.
